text:
elaine: quick pass on in-product docs panel this morning — three items to triage before next console deploy: dark-mode focus ring nearly invisible, docs deep-links don't consistently scroll to anchors, and inconsistent copy for model pinning vs freeze. posting here to coordinate.

sam: thanks! can you paste a short repro for the focus ring? i couldn't reproduce locally.

elaine: repro: console in dark mode, open model details > help panel, then tab to first link. outline is same hue as bg so keyboard users lose their spot.

mike: looks like we use --bg-elev for the ring; that collapses in dark. simple fix: switch :focus-visible ring to var(--accent-contrast) and make it a 2px solid outline for enough contrast.

jordan: accessibility note: panel sometimes opens without role=dialog on nested routes; close button isn't announced. i can add role/aria-modal and ensure focus trap attaches.

olivia: on copy: console CTA says "Pin model" while docs say "Freeze version" — customers are confused during rollouts. prefer a single canonical phrase. my take: "Pin model version" (explicit).

sam: +1 explicit. can we also A/B test copy? track clicks to see if phrasing reduces help pings.

docs-bot: FYI docs PR #1423 standardizes canonical term to "Pin model version" and adds redirect anchors for legacy links. https://docs.redwood.ai/concepts/pinning -> /pinning.

elaine: ok next steps I propose: (1) CSS change for focus-visible ring in dark, (2) ensure panel has role=dialog + attach trap on open, (3) update CTA copy to "Pin model version" and emit analytics event help_panel_pin_cta_clicked.

mike: found overlay-manager bug: when opening from nested routes attachTrap() is skipped. quick patch idea:
```js
const panel = openHelpPanel(opts);
panel.setAttribute('role','dialog');
attachTrap(panel);
panel.focus();
```

jordan: i'll add an axe check for dialog semantics and a keyboard smoke test in e2e so we don't regress.

olivia: deep-link issue: docs anchors like #pinning open console but don't scroll because console uses id="pin-model". can we normalize aliases on open (pinning, pin-model, freeze-version) and scroll to matched id?

elaine: yes — implement alias map and try fallback when anchor not found. also aria-bot suggestion: scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) then focus to avoid SRs losing position.

sam: add analytics event help_anchor_resolved with label resolved_alias. track which alias is used so docs+console teams can converge.

docs-bot: logged ENG-4312 to track anchor resolution + CTA clicks.

aria-bot: extra a11y note: when auto-scrolling, ensure visible focus ring is moved after scroll; otherwise keyboard users see focus on offscreen item. run screen-reader check on the flow too.

olivia: mock uploaded in Figma (link) with skip-link suggestion and contrast token callouts.

elaine: assignments: mike/jordan -> dialog + focus ring patch; olivia -> anchor alias list + copy update; sam -> analytics events; docs-bot -> coordinate docs redirects. target this week before deploy.

mike: i'll open PR with small CSS + TS fix and tag people. expect ~25 lines change.

jordan: will land axe test in e2e once PR is up.

olivia: i18n note: copy change needs keys updated across locales; i'll coordinate with intl.

sam: add short release note mentioning the accessibility fix and copy harmonization for enterprise customers.

eng-oncall: noted; tagging so we can watch overlay changes in prod sessions.

elaine: PRs referenced in thread when ready. i'll draft release blurb after merges. thanks all :thumbsup:
